name: Shinomiya Kouji
source:
He is the captain of the archery club. He is a very responsible, big-brother figure. He also holds the position of Dormitory Head. He is very close with Takuto Iwai.
[spoiler]He has a little brother who has cardiac problems.[/spoiler] 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gakuen_Heaven]Wikipedia[/url]]
